manifestContentHashMethod: sha256(JSON.stringify(parsed ADM3 manifest)); not a delivery hash
evidenceScope: LOCAL_RELEASE_CANDIDATE; hosted and mobile selection unobserved
areaMethod: Sum of effective spherical polygon areas / canonical parent area; not union coverage. Overlap QA is separate.
metadataCaveat: Official sourceSnapshotHash may be a per-geometry hash; exact upstream download hashes are in artifact-evidence.json.
